attributeScale: Peak of what a body or mind can do
skillScale: Professional: could earn a living with it
Master: one of the best alive

Strength.short: Raw muscle: lifting, breaking, hitting hard.
Strength.uses: Brawl and Melee damage, forcing doors, carrying.

Dexterity.short: Coordination, speed and a steady hand.

Stamina.short: How much punishment the body takes.
Stamina.uses: Sets Health (Stamina + 3); enduring pain and exertion.

Charisma.short: Presence and the pull to make people follow.
Charisma.uses: Leadership, Performance, many Presence and Dominate powers.

Manipulation.short: Steering people where they would not go alone.

Composure.short: Staying cool under pressure and against the Beast.
Composure.uses: Half of Willpower; resisting fear and frenzy.

Wits.short: Thinking fast and noticing the moment.

Resolve.short: Focus and stubborn will to see things through.
Resolve.uses: Half of Willpower; Auspex pools, long investigations.

Brawl.short: Fighting with fists, grapples and fangs.

Craft.short: Making things by hand. Always needs a specialty.

Drive.short: Handling vehicles at speed and in chases.

Melee.short: Fighting with blades, clubs and stakes.

Stealth.short: Moving and hiding without being noticed.

Survival.short: Tracking, and living rough outside the city.

Etiquette.short: Knowing the manners of a court or a crowd.

Intimidation.short: Threats, stares and making people back off.

Leadership.short: Getting a group to act together for you.

Performance.short: Art in front of an audience. Always needs a specialty.

Streetwise.short: Knowing the street, its rules and markets.

Subterfuge.short: Lying, misleading and keeping a straight face.

Academics.short: History, art and the humanities. Always needs a specialty.

Awareness.short: Noticing what is out of place, sensing danger.

Finance.short: Money, markets and following the trail of it.

Investigation.short: Finding clues and putting them together.

Medicine.short: Treating wounds, and knowing the body.

Occult.short: Lore of the supernatural and of Kindred.

Politics.short: How power works, mortal and Kindred.

Science.short: The natural sciences. Always needs a specialty.

Jack of all trades.short: A little of everything: one skill at 3, most others touched.
Jack of all trades.fits: Generalists, survivors, people who lived many lives.

Balanced.short: A few strengths and a solid base.
Balanced.fits: The usual pick: a clear role with backup skills.

Specialist.short: One skill at 4, the rest narrow.
Specialist.fits: Experts: the surgeon, the hacker, the duelist.

Animalism.short: Speak with, command and become kin to beasts and the Beast.

powers.name: Bond Famulus
powers.summary: Bind one animal as a loyal servant.

powers.name: Sense the Beast
powers.summary: Feel hostility and the Beast in others.

powers.name: Feral Whispers
powers.summary: Talk with animals and call them to you.

powers.name: Animal Succulence
powers.summary: Animal blood slakes more Hunger.

powers.name: Quell the Beast
powers.summary: Calm a mortal into apathy, or soothe a vampire.

Auspex.short: Senses beyond mortal limits, and glimpses into minds and futures.

powers.name: Heightened Senses
powers.summary: Senses sharpen far past mortal limits.

powers.name: Sense the Unseen
powers.summary: Notice hidden or supernatural presences.

powers.name: Premonition
powers.summary: Flashes of insight about what is coming.

powers.name: Scry the Soul
powers.summary: Read the aura and nature of someone.

powers.name: Share the Senses
powers.summary: See and hear through another Kindred.

powers.name: Cat's Grace
powers.summary: Perfect balance on any footing.

powers.name: Rapid Reflexes
powers.summary: React faster; small actions cost nothing.

powers.name: Fleetness
powers.summary: Add Celerity to defense and non-combat Dexterity.

powers.name: Blink
powers.summary: Close a distance in an instant.

powers.name: Traversal
powers.summary: Run up walls and across water.

Dominate.short: Bend minds with a look and a word.

powers.name: Cloud Memory
powers.summary: Make someone forget the last moments.

powers.name: Compel
powers.summary: A one-word order that must be obeyed.

powers.name: Mesmerize
powers.summary: Give a longer, detailed command.

powers.name: The Forgetful Mind
powers.summary: Rewrite a memory.

powers.name: Submerged Directive
powers.summary: Hide a command to trigger later.

Fortitude.short: Unnatural toughness of body and mind.

powers.name: Resilience
powers.summary: Add Fortitude to Health.

powers.name: Unswayable Mind
powers.summary: Extra dice to resist mind control.

powers.name: Toughness
powers.summary: Shrug off part of Superficial damage.

powers.name: Defy Bane
powers.summary: Turn Aggravated damage into Superficial.

powers.name: Fortify the Inner Façade
powers.summary: Hard to read with Auspex.

powers.name: Cloak of Shadows
powers.summary: Stay unseen while standing still.

powers.name: Silence of Death
powers.summary: Make no sound at all.

powers.name: Unseen Passage
powers.summary: Move while staying unseen.

powers.name: Ghost in the Machine
powers.summary: Obfuscate works on cameras too.

powers.name: Mask of a Thousand Faces
powers.summary: Look like a forgettable stranger.

Potence.short: Strength far beyond any living body.

powers.name: Lethal Body
powers.summary: Bare hands deal Aggravated damage to mortals.

powers.name: Soaring Leap
powers.summary: Jump far higher and longer.

powers.name: Prowess
powers.summary: Add Potence to Strength damage and feats.

powers.name: Brutal Feed
powers.summary: Drain a victim in seconds.

powers.name: Uncanny Grip
powers.summary: Cling to any surface.

Presence.short: Draw, awe and terrify crowds by emotion.

powers.name: Awe
powers.summary: Become the center of the room.

powers.name: Daunt
powers.summary: Make people back away.

powers.name: Lingering Kiss
powers.summary: Your victims crave your bite.

powers.name: Dread Gaze
powers.summary: Terrify one person into fleeing.

powers.name: Entrancement
powers.summary: Make someone devoted to you.

Protean.short: Reshape the body: claws, eyes, beast forms.

powers.name: Eyes of the Beast
powers.summary: See in total darkness.

powers.name: Weight of the Feather
powers.summary: Become nearly weightless; fall safely.

powers.name: Feral Weapons
powers.summary: Grow claws that deal Aggravated damage.

powers.name: Earth Meld
powers.summary: Sink into the earth to rest.

powers.name: Shapechange
powers.summary: Become an animal of your size.

Blood Sorcery.short: Blood magic, and the rituals of the Tremere and Banu Haqim.

powers.name: Corrosive Vitae
powers.summary: Your blood eats through objects.

powers.name: A Taste for Blood
powers.summary: Learn about someone from their blood.

powers.name: Extinguish Vitae
powers.summary: Make another vampire hungrier.

powers.name: Blood of Potency
powers.summary: Raise your Blood Potency for a night.

powers.name: Scorpion's Touch
powers.summary: Turn your blood into poison.

Thin-Blood Alchemy.short: Brew temporary powers from blood and ingredients instead of inheriting them.

powers.name: Far Reach
powers.summary: Move objects with the mind.

powers.name: Haze
powers.summary: Wrap yourself in a cloud of mist.

powers.name: Profane Hieros Gamos
powers.summary: Reshape a body's sex and features.

powers.name: Envelop
powers.summary: Smother a target in blinding mist.

powers.name: Defractionate
powers.summary: Make bagged or preserved blood nourishing again.

powers.name: Airborne Momentum
powers.summary: Fly for a short while.

powers.name: Awaken the Sleeper
powers.summary: Rouse a vampire from torpor.

clans.name: Brujah
clans.long: Philosophers turned street fighters. Brujah burn hot for causes, people and grudges, and they are the first to raise a fist against tyrants, Kindred or mortal.
clans.play: Passion, conviction and a temper that becomes a problem.

bane.name: Violent Temper
bane.text: Fewer dice to resist fury frenzy.

compulsion.name: Rebellion
compulsion.text: Must defy someone in authority, or suffer a penalty.

clans.name: Gangrel
clans.long: Loners closest to the Beast. Gangrel roam the edges of cities and wilds, survive anything, and come back from frenzy with something animal left behind.
clans.play: Independence, instinct and bodies that change.

bane.name: Bestial Features
bane.text: Frenzy leaves animal traits that weaken attributes.

compulsion.name: Feral Impulses
compulsion.text: Speech and reasoning drop to the animal for a while.

clans.name: Malkavian
clans.long: Every Malkavian is touched by a madness that sees what others miss. Prophets, jesters and oracles, they are feared because they are so often right.
clans.play: Insight that costs sanity, and a mind that is never quite safe.

bane.name: Fractured Perspective
bane.text: A bestial failure or compulsion clouds one kind of roll for the scene.

compulsion.name: Delusion
compulsion.text: Perceptions twist; senses and judgment suffer.

clans.name: Nosferatu
clans.long: Hideous since the Embrace, the Nosferatu live in sewers and networks. They trade in secrets and know more about the city than anyone wants.
clans.play: Information brokering, stealth and a face no one can look at.

bane.name: Repulsiveness
bane.text: Can never pass as beautiful; disguising as human is harder.

compulsion.name: Cryptophilia
compulsion.text: Must learn a secret before anything else.

clans.name: Toreador
clans.long: Artists, lovers and connoisseurs. Toreador collect beauty and people, set the fashions of Elysium, and suffer badly when the world turns ugly.
clans.play: Society, art and charm, with a weakness for the sublime.

bane.name: Aesthetic Fixation
bane.text: Fewer dice on Discipline rolls in ugly or squalid places.

compulsion.name: Obsession
compulsion.text: Fixates on one beautiful thing until satisfied.

clans.name: Tremere
clans.long: Once a pyramid of warlocks, now a broken house of sorcerers. Tremere practice blood magic, keep secrets, and are distrusted by everyone.
clans.play: Rituals, research and ambition inside a fallen hierarchy.

bane.name: Deficient Blood
bane.text: Cannot Blood Bond other Kindred; mortals need extra drinks.

compulsion.name: Perfectionism
compulsion.text: Only a flawless result is good enough.

clans.name: Ventrue
clans.long: The aristocrats of the night. Ventrue lead the Camarilla, own the boardrooms, and can only feed on one kind of prey.
clans.play: Leadership, wealth and command, with picky tastes.

bane.name: Rarefied Tastes
bane.text: Can only feed on one type of victim; others cost Willpower.

clans.name: Banu Haqim
clans.long: Assassins and judges who feed on the guilty. The Banu Haqim recently joined the Camarilla and remain its sharpest, most dangerous blade.
clans.play: Justice, discipline and a thirst for Kindred blood.

bane.name: Blood Addiction
bane.text: Drinking vampire blood risks a hunger frenzy.

compulsion.name: Judgment
compulsion.text: Must punish whoever breaks one of their Convictions.

clans.name: The Ministry
clans.long: Followers of Set who free people by corrupting them. The Ministry deals in temptation, cults and secrets, and is welcome among the Anarchs.
clans.play: Temptation, faith and pushing others past their limits.

bane.name: Abhorrent of Light
bane.text: Bright light weakens them; sunlight burns worse.

compulsion.name: Transgression
compulsion.text: Must lead someone to break a principle.

clans.name: Caitiff
clans.long: Embraced without a clan, or abandoned by one. Caitiff have no bane and no birthright, choose any disciplines, and are looked down on by everyone.

bane.name: None
bane.text: Starts with the Suspect flaw and no Status.

clans.name: Thin-blooded
clans.long: Too far from Caine to be fully vampires. Thin-bloods walk in daylight sometimes, eat food, and brew alchemy instead of true disciplines.
clans.play: Half-mortal, improvised powers, despised by elders.

predators.name: Alleycat
predators.short: Takes blood by force: ambush, mugging, threat.

predators.name: Bagger
predators.short: Steals or buys bagged blood: hospitals, blood banks, the black market.

predators.name: Blood Leech
predators.short: Feeds on other vampires. Powerful, and a crime.

predators.name: Cleaver
predators.short: Feeds in secret on a family or circle that does not know.

predators.name: Consensualist
predators.short: Only feeds with consent: a clinic, a kink, a study.

predators.name: Farmer
predators.short: Feeds only on animals, holding on to Humanity.

predators.name: Osiris
predators.short: A celebrity or cult leader fed by followers.
predators.extras: 3 dots of Fame or Herd; 2 dots of Enemy or Mythic flaws

predators.name: Sandman
predators.short: Breaks in and feeds on sleepers who never wake.

predators.name: Scene Queen
predators.short: A fixture of a subculture who feeds on its people.
predators.extras: Fame •, Contact •, Disliked • or Prey Exclusion •

predators.name: Siren
predators.short: Seduces victims and feeds in intimacy.

Childer.short: Embraced recently, still learning what you are.

Neonate.short: A few years in the night, found your feet.

Ancilla.short: Decades of unlife, with power and old debts.
Ancilla.note: +35 XP, +2 advantage points, +2 flaw points, −1 Humanity.

advantages.name: Allies
advantages.short: Mortals who help you when it counts.

advantages.name: Contacts
advantages.short: People who pass you information and favors.

advantages.name: Fame
advantages.short: Mortal celebrity: open doors, hard to hide.

advantages.name: Haven
advantages.short: A safe place to rest by day.

advantages.name: Herd
advantages.short: Willing vessels you can feed on easily.

advantages.name: Influence
advantages.short: Pull over a mortal group or institution.

advantages.name: Mask
advantages.short: A fake mortal identity with papers.

advantages.name: Mawla
advantages.short: An older Kindred mentor who has your back.

advantages.name: Resources
advantages.short: Money and the lifestyle it buys.

advantages.name: Retainers
advantages.short: Loyal servants, often ghouls.

advantages.name: Status
advantages.short: Standing in your sect.

advantages.name: Beautiful
advantages.short: +1 die on social rolls where looks matter.

advantages.name: Linguistics
advantages.short: One extra language per dot.

advantages.name: Bloodhound
advantages.short: Smell the Resonance in mortal blood.

advantages.name: Iron Gullet
advantages.short: Feed on rancid or bagged blood without trouble.

advantages.name: Eat Food
advantages.short: Eat and keep down mortal food.

advantages.name: Prey Exclusion
advantages.short: There is a kind of victim you refuse to feed on.

advantages.name: Dark Secret
advantages.short: Something that would ruin you if known.

advantages.name: Enemy
advantages.short: Someone who wants you harmed.

advantages.name: Suspect
advantages.short: Your sect does not trust you.

advantages.name: Destitute
advantages.short: No money and no home.

advantages.name: Known Corpse
advantages.short: People know you died.

advantages.name: Ugly
advantages.short: −1 die on social rolls where looks matter.

advantages.name: Addiction
advantages.short: Needs blood carrying a drug, or suffers.

advantages.name: Folkloric Bane
advantages.short: A folk-tale object (silver, garlic) burns you.

blood.Health: How much damage you take. Stamina + 3 boxes. Superficial damage (/) from most weapons is halved; Aggravated (X) comes from fire, sun and claws. A full track of Aggravated means torpor.
blood.Willpower: Inner strength. Composure + Resolve boxes. Spend one to re-roll up to three regular dice. Full track: −2 dice on Social and Mental rolls.
blood.Hunger: How badly the Beast wants blood, 0 to 5. Each point turns one die of every pool into a Hunger die, which can cause messy criticals and bestial failures.
blood.Humanity: What is left of the person. 0 to 10, starts at 7. Stains from monstrous acts may cost a dot at the end of the session.
blood.Blood Potency: The power of your blood. Sets Blood Surge, how much you mend per Rouse Check, discipline bonus dice and Bane Severity.
blood.Resonance: The emotion in the last blood you drank. Strong Resonance gives a bonus die to matching disciplines.

identity.Concept: Who you were before and what you are now, in a few words. Guides how you play.
identity.Chronicle: The game or city this character lives in.
identity.Clan: Your bloodline: three easy disciplines, a bane and a compulsion. Set at creation.
identity.Predator: How you hunt. Set at creation; it gave a specialty, a discipline dot and some advantages.
identity.Ambition: The long-term goal. Working toward it heals Aggravated Willpower.
identity.Generation: Steps from Caine. Lower generations can reach higher Blood Potency.
identity.Sire: The vampire who Embraced you. Often a story hook, sometimes a Mawla or an Enemy.
identity.Desire: A short-term want for this session. Acting on it restores Willpower.
identity.Age: How long since the Embrace: childer, neonate or ancilla.

convictionHelp: A moral line you will not cross, tied to a mortal Touchstone who embodies it. Losing the Touchstone shakes your Humanity.

rituals.name: Blood Walk
rituals.summary: Read a subject's lineage of sires from a taste of their blood.

rituals.name: Clinging of the Insect
rituals.summary: Cling to walls and ceilings like a spider.

rituals.name: Craft Bloodstone
rituals.summary: Make a stone of your blood that you can always find again.

rituals.name: Wake with Evening's Freshness
rituals.summary: Wake up at once when danger comes during the day.

rituals.name: Ward against Ghouls
rituals.summary: An object warded to hurt any ghoul who touches it.

rituals.name: Communicate with Kindred Sire
rituals.summary: Speak mind to mind with your sire, wherever they are.

rituals.name: Eyes of Babel
rituals.summary: Understand and speak a language taken from another.

rituals.name: Illuminate the Trail of Prey
rituals.summary: See the path your quarry walked glow before you.

rituals.name: Truth of Blood
rituals.summary: Taste blood to tell whether its owner speaks the truth.

rituals.name: Ward against Spirits
rituals.summary: An object warded to hurt spirits and ghosts.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Ghouls
rituals.summary: A circle that ghouls cannot cross unharmed.

rituals.name: Dagon's Call
rituals.summary: Drown someone from within, through blood you once touched.

rituals.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
rituals.summary: Stakes cannot pierce your heart while it lasts.

rituals.name: Essence of Air
rituals.summary: Your body turns light as air and floats.

rituals.name: Ward against Lupines
rituals.summary: An object warded to hurt werewolves.

rituals.name: Warding Circle against Spirits
rituals.summary: A circle spirits cannot cross unharmed.

thinBloodMerits.name: Anarch Comrades
thinBloodMerits.short: Anarch allies who look out for you.

thinBloodMerits.name: Camarilla Contact
thinBloodMerits.short: Someone in the Camarilla who will talk to you.

thinBloodMerits.name: Catenating Blood
thinBloodMerits.short: Your blood can bond and Embrace like a true vampire.

thinBloodMerits.name: Day Drinker
thinBloodMerits.short: You can walk in sunlight, weakened.

thinBloodMerits.name: Discipline Affinity
thinBloodMerits.short: One discipline stays with you at one dot.

thinBloodMerits.name: Lifelike
thinBloodMerits.short: Your body passes for a living one.

thinBloodMerits.name: Thin-blood Alchemist
thinBloodMerits.short: You start with Thin-Blood Alchemy and a formula.

thinBloodMerits.name: Vampiric Resilience
thinBloodMerits.short: You take damage like a full vampire.

thinBloodFlaws.name: Baby Teeth
thinBloodFlaws.short: Your fangs are useless for feeding.

thinBloodFlaws.name: Bestial Temper
thinBloodFlaws.short: You frenzy as easily as true Kindred.

thinBloodFlaws.name: Clan Curse
thinBloodFlaws.short: You carry the bane of the clan that made you.

thinBloodFlaws.name: Dead Flesh
thinBloodFlaws.short: You look and smell dead to mortals.

thinBloodFlaws.name: Shunned by the Anarchs
thinBloodFlaws.short: The Anarchs want nothing to do with you.

alchemyMethods.name: Calcinatio
alchemyMethods.short: Distill by reducing blood and ingredients to ash.

alchemyMethods.name: Fixatio
alchemyMethods.short: Distill in a laboratory, slowly and precisely.

domain.Chasse: How rich the hunting ground is: each dot makes hunting there easier.
domain.Lien: How well the coterie knows its streets: extra dice for actions inside the domain.
domain.Portillon: How well guarded it is: fewer dice for intruders acting against you there.
